Local Dniester boundary follows the built-in modern watercourse by user approval (2026-10-25); not a surveyed or legally delimited 1922 thalweg. Baseline ZIP hashes remain evidence identifiers, not hashes of this locally adjusted geometry. The approximately 1 km river-to-preserved-coast closure (2.87 CSS pixels at app maximum zoom) is geometric inference, not independently established historical boundary. Modern river/shared sections preserved; only confirmed Latvia dry-land detail lightly simplified. Original ZIP hashes identify baseline evidence, not this adjusted geometry.
